# ClearWork

> ClearWork is India's all-in-one client workflow platform for freelancers and
> small agencies — proposals, contracts, GST invoices, and Razorpay payments
> connected in a single tool.

Built for 15 million Indian independent professionals who need CGST/SGST/IGST
auto-split invoicing, OTP e-signatures valid under IT Act 2000, TDS 194J/194C
flagging, UPI/Razorpay payment collection, and WhatsApp payment reminders.

## Core Features
- GST invoices: CGST/SGST intra-state, IGST inter-state, auto-detected by client state
- E-sign contracts: OTP-based, legally valid under Information Technology Act 2000
- Proposals: open tracking, time-spent-per-section analytics, one-click contract conversion
- Client portal: single link, no login required for clients
- WhatsApp automations: payment reminders at 3, 7, 14 days overdue
- Free tools: GST calculator, TDS calculator, invoice generator, contract generator

## Pricing
- Free forever plan (no credit card)
- Paid plans from ₹699/month
- No transaction fees

## Blog — Authoritative Guides for Indian Freelancers

ClearWork publishes practical, India-specific guides on GST invoicing, legal
contracts, e-signatures, and freelance finance. Each article targets the exact
questions Indian freelancers search for and links to the relevant free tool.

### How to Create a GST Invoice in India
URL: https://getclearwork.in/blog/how-to-create-gst-invoice-india
Covers: who needs GST invoices (₹20L threshold), all mandatory fields under
Rule 46 CGST Rules 2017, CGST/SGST vs IGST logic with state examples, SAC
codes for 10 freelance service types, invoice due dates, export invoices
(zero-rated), and common mistakes that invalidate ITC claims.
Related tool: https://getclearwork.in/tools/gst-invoice-generator

### Is E-Signature Legal in India?
URL: https://getclearwork.in/blog/is-e-signature-legal-india
Covers: IT Act 2000 Section 5 legal basis, three signature types (DSC,
Aadhaar/OTP eSign, simple e-sign), which contracts can and cannot be e-signed
(negotiable instruments, wills, property deeds excluded), enforceability
requirements (audit trail, Section 65B evidence), e-signature vs digital
signature comparison, how OTP-based signing satisfies IT Act Second Schedule,
stamp duty considerations, and practical tips for freelancers.
Related tool: https://getclearwork.in/tools/freelance-contract-generator

### TDS on Freelance Income: Section 194J vs 194C Explained
URL: https://getclearwork.in/blog/tds-on-freelance-income-194j-194c-india
Covers: why Section 194J (10%) applies to most Indian freelancers rather than
194C, TDS rates and ₹30,000 threshold, who must deduct (companies/firms/audit-
liable individuals), how to verify deductions in Form 26AS, claiming TDS refund
in ITR by reporting gross income, Form 15G/15H eligibility, and obtaining Form
16A from clients. FAQ covers GST+TDS on same invoice.
Related tool: https://getclearwork.in/tools/tds-calculator

### How to Write a Freelance Contract in India (That Actually Protects You)
URL: https://getclearwork.in/blog/how-to-write-freelance-contract-india
Covers: 8 essential clauses — scope of work + change request clause, payment
terms with 30-50% advance + late payment interest, IP ownership transferring
only on full payment, revision policy, termination kill fee (30%), mutual NDA,
arbitration vs civil court jurisdiction, and OTP e-sign under IT Act 2000
Second Schedule. Highlights common mistakes: using Western templates, missing
TDS clause, leaving jurisdiction blank, no advance before final delivery.
Related tool: https://getclearwork.in/tools/freelance-contract-generator

### Old vs New Tax Regime for Freelancers in India (2026): Which One Saves More?
URL: https://getclearwork.in/blog/old-vs-new-tax-regime-freelancer-india
Covers: Budget 2025 new regime slabs (nil up to ₹4L, effective zero-tax limit
₹12.75L via 87A rebate + ₹75K standard deduction), old regime slabs with 80C/
80D/HRA deductions, deductions table, three worked examples at ₹8L/₹15L/₹25L
all showing new regime winning, Section 44ADA presumptive taxation (50% of
receipts, ₹75L cap, ITR-4 Sugam), ITR form selection table, Form 10-IEA
switching deadline 31 July 2026, and when old regime still makes sense
(HRA > ₹2L or total deductions > ₹3.75L).
Related tool: https://getclearwork.in/tools/income-tax-calculator
